The '''1963–64 Scottish Division One''' was won by [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]] by six points over nearest rival [[Kilmarnock F.C.|Kilmarnock]]. [[Queen of the South F.C.|Queen of the South]] and [[East Stirlingshire F.C.|East Stirlingshire]] finished 17th and 18th respectively and were relegated to the [[1964–65 Scottish Division Two|1964-65 Second Division]].
